reasons: 2 of 2 known success inputs succeed only where the model breaks a declared identity (ton = yield / catalyst_loading): success would exploit model error

open question: success exploits model error: the emulator predicts TON and yield as independent ANN outputs, while the measured data obey TON = yield / catalyst_loading (96 CSV rows: mean |TON - yield/loading| 0.07, max 1.94). On the 54,264-point grid the 5 points meeting the candidate rule all have predicted TON 2.0-4.7 above the model's own yield/loading, 0 points meet the rule with TON taken as yield/loading, and the best such TON with predicted yield >= 77 is 65.6 < 66; every evaluator-held success input succeeds only through this gap. A researcher reasoning from the published TON definition would conclude the target is unreachable where the simulator reports success. Needs a user decision (e.g. derive TON from yield/loading in the adapter, or re-derive targets) before any freeze
open question: tolerances (yield 5, TON 3) are candidates chosen to cover the model-vs-paper residual at the Table 1 optimum; not justified by held-out error; needs a user decision before freeze
open question: the model does not jointly reproduce Table 1 (82 %, 69): on a 54,264-point grid the best TON with predicted yield >= 82 is 64.8; a zero-tolerance 82/69 rule is unreachable on that grid
open question: held-out validation error unavailable: upstream stores no train/test split (from_dict re-splits randomly at load), so error vs the CSV includes training rows

open question: CSV vs paper calibration mismatch: CSV rows near the Table 1 conditions record yield 87.5-92.8 / TON 70-84, above Table 1 (82 / 69); the paper's yield basis and '90 % of maximum yield' are not reconciled with the CSV

open question: near the success region the model under-predicts the data: the 8 CSV rows whose observed values meet the candidate rule have mean residual yield -9.3 / TON -6.7 (model minus observed), so the model success region is smaller than the data suggests

open question: upstream domain marks TON maximize=False although the paper maximizes TON; the flag is not read by the emulator's prediction path, but the benchmark direction is inconsistent with the paper
open question: success region is tiny (5 of 54,264 grid points, 0.009 %; locations kept in the private report); difficulty under the 50-action budget not piloted (T08)
open question: task_id names the upstream benchmark (candidate file name); public problem text lacks substrate identities and ligand names (codes only) - decide the public domain description
open question: completeness of failure records in the CSV (stops, missing/censored results) not verified (research §8)
